heroLead: Voyager Maps has 13,232 practical places mapped in London — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in London. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in London on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in London
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In London it currently holds 904 public toilets and 604 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 2,061 places in London are recorded as having step-free access.
